biography.text: Arek Borucki is an ML Platform & Database Engineer at Hugging Face, where he designs and operates MongoDB Atlas infrastructure behind the Hugging Face Hub. His work focuses on scalability, reliability and database performance for machine-learning workloads. A MongoDB Community Champion since 2020, he founded the Munich MongoDB User Group and helps develop and validate MongoDB certifications. He is the author of MongoDB 8.0 in Action and co-author of Mastering MongoDB 7.0, and a recipient of the 2025 William Zola Award for Community Excellence.
